sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Elderly near-frontal woman with silver-white center-part hair beneath tied white headscarf, grey brows and thin oval metal spectacles over eyes. Off-white broad-lapel lab coat over small black/white patterned pointed blouse; cropped blue hardback book with cream page edge held at viewer right. Serious closed mouth, blue background. Preserve scarf/hair/glasses/brows/book/clothing, pose/crop/light; short broad fitted mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Elderly near-frontal woman, silver-grey side waves under flat dark brown pillbox hat, pale brows, pearl-like round earrings. Dark brown lapelled jacket/small silver wing pin viewer left over brown/beige patterned V blouse. Viewer-right hand holds a thin lit cigarette, with wispy smoke on blue background. Preserve hat/hair/earrings/pin/blouse/hand/cigarette/smoke and crop/light, serious closed mouth; compact mascot head, short broad neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Elderly woman nearly frontal slightly toward viewer left, swept-back white-grey waved hair and grey brows, silver dangling geometric earrings. Grey broad-lapel jacket over pink/cream thin-striped neck-tied blouse. Serious closed downturned mouth, blue background. Preserve actual hair/brows/earrings/jacket/neck tie, pose/crop/light; short broad fitted mascot neck and single simple mouth.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal clean-shaven man, short side-part light brown combed hair and dark brows, small round metal spectacles covering eyes. Brown broad-lapel coat, white pointed shirt, dark navy tie. Serious closed mouth on full blue background. Preserve hair/brows/glasses and outfit, pose/crop/light; compact green-eyed mascot with short broad fitted collar transition, no added beard/moustache.
